parsed.post: Despite the leakage, the 0.880952 result is a significant improvement over our current best 0.945254 in the '0-10' regime. If the pattern holds, we are finding a much better local optimum for the hyperparameters even within the contaminated space. Moving to test a lower learning rate to continue the descent.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.06 to follow the observed trend of lower LR improving val_bpb in the leaky 0-10 regime.
